description: This file defines a custom exception handler class for the blivet-gui application, including methods for parsing exceptions, handling exceptions, and integrating with GTK dialogs and system commands.

classes.name: BlivetGUIExceptionHandler
classes.description: A class that manages exception handling for the blivet-gui application, including parsing exceptions, displaying dialogs, and reporting errors.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the exception handler with the main window and the original excepthook.

methods.name: _parse_exception
methods.description: Parses an exception value to separate the traceback message from the main exception message.

methods.name: handle_exception
methods.description: Handles an exception by displaying a dialog, optionally reporting, and re-raising or terminating the application.
